wide.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: finished raster background artwork for a Unity poker player namecard, wide 8:3 version.
Input images: Image 1 (4:3) is supporting identity/detail reference; image 2 (8:3) is the edit target. Edit the supplied wide illustration, not a new unrelated scene.
Primary request: polish this illustration into an elegant, UI-readable fantasy namecard. Output ONE full-bleed exact 2048 x 768 PNG, 8:3.
Preserve: both original anime characters, their recognizable face/hair/outfit designs, seated back-to-back pose, flowing violet multicolored hair, indigo/cyan crystalline cavern and flower carpet. Keep the pair on the right roughly 62–85% of width, enough breathing room around heads, flowing hair toward lower left; original artwork aesthetic and anatomy. No added characters.
Change: convert the original very bright illustration to a restrained twilight blue-violet tonal background. Faces, pale hair, hands, clothes and flowers inside the content area are all subdued, low-contrast colored mid-dark forms; pale hair becomes smoky lavender, flowers muted antique gold, no white patches. Central and left 60% quiet and deep blue with visible soft cavern detail, not blank black. Character faces still legible as art but subordinate to future warm-white UI. About 12–28% perceived background brightness throughout central area; highlights heavily compressed, not merely a black opaque rectangle over art.
Turn the luminous orb into a dim violet translucent sphere with no white core and no glowing halo. Remove bright floating sparks and bokeh from the interior. Retain a few subdued petals.
Add a very fine refined cool silver-lilac perimeter line and tiny understated flower/crystal corner details, inspired by the scene. At 2048x768, ALL brighter lines, solid frame ornaments and obvious glows must lie in outermost 48 pixels, NEVER more than 64 pixels from the nearest image edge. No large medallions. Frame must not overlap characters.
Reserve inset 96px on all four sides as uninterrupted low-contrast UI-compatible image background. No visible safety lines or reserved panels. Full opaque complete background, no cutout hole.
Avoid: text, letters, names, numbers, logo, watermark, poker suits, chips, crowns, UI icons, mockup layout, thick ornate border, harsh black vignette, empty black interior, oversaturated gold, lens flares, luminous center, bright faces.
Deliver only the finished wide artwork, no comparison board.

compact.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: finished raster background artwork for a Unity poker player namecard, compact 4:3 companion.
Input images: Image 1 is the original 4:3 illustration EDIT TARGET; image 2 is its original wide supporting scene; image 3 is the approved wide namecard appearance reference. Match image 3's deep twilight blue-violet tonal treatment and delicate silver-lilac perimeter frame.
Primary request: independently recompose and polish the original 4:3 illustration into a 4:3 compact UI-readable namecard. Output ONE full-bleed exact 1024 x 768 PNG. Must be exact 4:3, NOT a squeezed or center-cropped version of the wide namecard.
Preserve: the original two anime characters, recognizable faces/hair/outfits, back-to-back sitting, long flowing violet multicolored hair, indigo/cyan crystalline cavern, flower carpet, dim violet sphere. Keep faces intact and visible, no anatomy changes. Pair on right with generous headroom; their flowing hair and legs sweep into lower left. Independently fit pose to compact shape, with quiet upper-left and central-left cavern. No new characters.
Style/color: match the third reference's refined anime illustration and muted twilight violet/indigo palette. Faces, white hair, hands, clothes, flowers are low-contrast colored mid-dark forms so future white names/gold balances remain dominant. Smoky lavender hair, muted antique gold flowers. Central content roughly 12–28% perceived brightness, compressed highlights. Do not turn entire illustration to solid black; maintain visibly colored, complete softly detailed background. The orb must be dim purple with no bright core, no glow ring. No bright particles in center.
Frame: same extremely thin cool silver-lilac double perimeter line, positioned 18–28 pixels from edges; microscopic flower and crystal motifs in four corners. At 1024x768 ALL solid bright ornaments and glows stay within outermost 48px, absolutely no more than 64px from nearest edge. Corner flowers must be small, under 36px across. Do not inflate frame thickness to compensate for narrower image.
UI: interior safe area is x96..928,y96..672 on 1024x768 canvas. Entire area is quiet low-contrast artwork, no white highlights. Keep complete image background inside, no empty panel, no guide lines.
Avoid: text, letters, numerals, names, logos, watermarks, poker suits or UI icons, thick frame, large corner ornaments, luminous flowers, sharp glowing stars, white faces/hair, central highlight, transparent/black hole, added panels, comparison board.
Deliver only the finished compact artwork.
